name: Cyclonus
_notes: Transcribed from sheet BU0724 (front Lv I-IV / back Lv V-IX), AI BR0725-BR0744, BP BS0746-BS0763, Routine Infuriating Roar (BR0744 / Mnestis BR0744-M), Signature Maul Smash BR0743.

Combo track (Bred for War): Mauls (Knife/Shield/Slabsword/Whip) -> Chain (Club/Axe/Bow) -> Body (Spear/Sword/Cestus). Combo Break: a non-PT Titan exhausts an unexhausted Weapon of the listed class while in its effective range.
Kratos Roll: d10 >= Rage succeeds, otherwise draw a Kratos card (no Fate re-roll). Danger Zone (D): the 4 side-adjacent spaces.

traits.Bred for War: Additional Setup: Place a Combo token on the Maul space of the Combo track. After resolving a Combo or Combo Break, move the token clockwise to the next space. Combo: After resolving the first AI card in a Round, perform ⚡ Combo: Draw and resolve another AI card. Combo Break: A Titan who is not the Priority Target, and has a Weapon with a Weapon class indicated by the Combo track, may exhaust this Weapon to break the Combo. The Titan must be within this Weapon's effective range. It gains the Priority Target token. Note: Rage gain doesn't trigger PT change.
traits.The Strong Eat: Additional Setup: Add 1 You died! Obol to the Obol deck.
traits.Eye for an Eye: Each time Cyclonus gains a Wound (a Double Wound is treated as 2 Wounds) or performs an unbroken Combo, place a token on this Trait. If there are 4 or more tokens on this Trait, finish resolving the current action, discard all tokens, then draw and resolve the top AI card.
traits.Unbeatable Guard: During the Titan Round, Cyclonus cannot be Wounded from the front and Combos cannot be broken from the front. Ignore this Trait during a Cyclonus Attack.
traits.Lesser Danger Sense: The D letters on the Primordial Diagram mark the Danger Zone spaces (the 4 side-adjacent spaces). If a Titan moves through the Danger Zone during the Titan Round, roll a d10. On a 7+, they manage to get through. Otherwise, they gain +2 Danger. Ignore this Trait during a Cyclonus Attack.
traits.End of Hope: End of Primordial Round: Perform Signature.
traits.Hyperaggression: Add +1 to all Pushbacks and Pulls and +2 to all Knockbacks performed by the Cyclonus.
traits.Dreadnought: During the Titan Round, Cyclonus can only be Wounded from its Blindspot. Combos can be broken only from the Blindspot.
traits.Crimson Tide: Start of Primordial Round: Perform Routine.
traits.Beginning of the End: End of Primordial Round: Before End of Hope, draw and perform another AI card. Additional Setup: Alternate Battle Diagram.
traits.Ruthless: Remove all positive Trauma cards from the Trauma decks (except Obols).
traits.Leleges Spin: Start of Primordial Round: Place one generic token on this Trait. Signature becomes a Zone Attack performed in Zone X, where X is the number of tokens on this Trait.
